Name: Floating Candles for Fashion Sense
Author: joondanoon
Description:
Animated floating candles as accessoires for [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿, just in time for spooky season :)

[img]https://i.ibb.co/7r0ppPn/variations.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*]Choose from 3 pre-made color variations, plus a customizable flame color version.
[*]Each color option comes with both a static and a dynamic version that rotates with your character.
[*]All variations come with a glowing and non-glowing version.
[*]16 options in total :)
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/KVj3srt/installation.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]﻿Unzip [FS] Floating Candles into your Stardew Valley/mods folder.
[*]Either start out your playthough with the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url]﻿ or buy it at Pierre's for 1500 gold.
[*]You can find the candles at the 'Accessoires' tab.
[/list]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fGqcwVT/credits.png[/img]
